verdict.rationale: Temporal's own docs describe the self-hosted service as "open source infrastructure software," and the server source is published in a public GitHub repository (temporalio/temporal), so users can read the source under an open-source model. Missing for 10: the specific license is never named in the evidence, the evidence does not confirm which components (SDKs, Web UI, CLI) are open versus Cloud-only, and there is no independent corroboration of the licensing terms.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: This guide shows you how to self-host open source infrastructure software that orchestrates your durable applications.
